high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "howeverythingworks." The post provides an educational guide on how to read a windsock, which is a tool used to indicate wind direction and speed. Image Content: The main focus of the image is a red-and-white striped windsock mounted on a pole against a clear blue sky. To the right of the windsock, there are four illustrations showing different positions of the windsock's flag and corresponding wind speeds in various units (knots, kilometers per hour, miles per hour, and meters per second). 2
